notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Photon Mine beams now resize depending on the number of enemies. Solo target? Big fat beam. Crowd? Slimmer beams.
[*] Laser Ray progression updated — power gives you more rays instead of more salvos.
[*] Corrected a bug where Lace Larvae and Home Centipede were slowed due to skipping one additional update frame.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]This patch is a big one. For the last week and a bit, I went under the hood of the game, rebuilt tons of systems, and cleaned up old code that was slowing everything down. The goal was simple: make the game run faster, smootherr, and more fun. The result? A 2x–4x performance boost depending on what’s happening on screen![/p][p] [/p][h3]Massive Performance Boost[/h3][p]■ Hundreds of scripts were rewritten, refactored, and optimized.[/p][p]■ You can now have 2x–4x more bullets, enemies, and effects on screen while keeping the same FPS.[/p][p]■ Big chaotic battles should feel much smoother and more stable.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Fixes & Balance Improvements[/h3][p]■ All weapons, abilities, and enemies were checked and adjusted.[/p][p]■ Fixed multiple bugs where collider sizes didn’t match visuals (e.g., some explosions were 2x larger than they looked).[/p][p]■ Sun Cross skill now correctly deals full damage.[/p][p]■ Spider web duration reduced by half for better balance.[/p][p]■ Countless small fixes and tweaks to make combat feel tighter and more balanced.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Worm Bosses & Long Worm Enemies[/h3][p]■ These legendary FPS-eaters finally got the attention they deserved:[/p][p]■ Worm bosses with hundreds of body segments are now 40–85% faster on CPU, meaning up to +35% better frame rates in those heavy fights.[/p][p]■ Fixed bug where you could sometimes kill the boss before it had spawned all its segments.[/p][p]■ Regular worm-type mobs with long mesh bodies are now 30–60% lighter on CPU as well.[/p][p]■ Worm fights are now smoother, more epic, and a lot less laggy.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Fun & Gameplay[/h3][p]■ Every weapon and skill now comes with its own enemy corpse toss power.[/p][p]■ The heavier the weapon → the faster enemies will fly when defeated.[/p][p]■ More heavy weapons = more fun! 💥[/p][p]■ It’s not just a visual gag – it makes weapons feel weightier and more unique.[/p][p]■ Expect battles to look wilder, funnier, and more chaotic than before![/p]

notes.title: 1.0.23 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changes & Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Previously, after a stretch without kills, on-kill abilities would generate bubbles you could trigger manually. Now, those bubbles also spawn when you enter a room. So players can fire them off in boss fights without needing trash mobs.
[*] Previously, high HP/armor let you stand inside a boss, hold fire, and land every shot with trivial contact damage—basically an exploit. Now contact damage ramps by +100% each tick (100%, 200%, 300%, 400%, 500%, …)
[/list]
[h3]Bugs Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skull Death ability— fixed an issue where only one skull spawned instead of multiple.
[*] Icicle Death ability — bullet quantity no longer stuck; scales properly.
[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pools now auto-shrink when idle, boosting performance and reducing memory use.
[*] Trials — worm-type bosses are now destroyed instead of merely deactivated, reducing memory use and improving performance.
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Explosions — reduced cumulative loudness when many occur at once
[/list]
Fixed issue where some boss attacks (Bull Ant, Black Widow, Solifuge) failed to summon after pooling system upgrade.

notes.title: 1.0.21 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added settings to reduce bullet and effect opacity, improving character visibility during heavy on-screen action.
[*] Improved performance with redesigned object pooling.
[*] Reworked rocket/bolt bullets so their trails have fixed length instead of stretching at extreme speeds.
[*] Fixed homing missiles—no more half-second stop bug.
[*] Fixed missing animation for Skeleton Death ability.
[*] Rebalanced some weapons—for example, Rocket Barrage now fires extra rockets.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.20 Update
notes.content: Potion hotkeys can now be remapped.

notes.title: 1.0.19 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Inventory now supports item locking — keep your items safe from selling and sorting.
[*] Capped stats now show overflow in red brackets, helping you optimize your build more effectively.
[*] Added a label that displays the total sell value of all items when using the Sell All button.
[*] Resolved an issue with the shared storage notice panel not disappearing.
[*] Crit chance cap 50%→100%, autoskill cooldown -1%→-0.5% per node, heal duration 0.5s→0.2s per node.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.18 Update
notes.content: Fixed tooltip issue in some places showing shop price instead of player sell value.

notes.title: 1.0.17 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Inventory now includes a sorting button with three modes: rarity, shape, and price.
[*] Tooltips now show item cost even outside shops, helping players gauge item power.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.16 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added small toggle buttons to allow or block selling of rare/epic/legendary gems via the Sell All button.
[*] Resolved a bug where invincibility on room entry ended prematurely when dashing. Immortality now continues after dash.
[*] Gem tooltips now appear on the battlefield by default. You can hide them with a dedicated button. This helps players who missed the small tutorial and only checked items through the inventory.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.15 Update
notes.content: Off-screen enemies and chests of varying rarity are now marked with colored arrows on the screen borders.

notes.title: 1.0.14 Update
notes.content: Added small toggle buttons to allow or block selling of potions and star/arrow gems via the Sell All button.

notes.title: 1.0.13 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed the post-purchase refresh of stat conversion buttons in Gem Forge to maintain better balance.
[*] Reforging a gem’s shape will no longer revert it to its initial or current form.
[*] Fixed an issue where Gem Forge’s stat conversion buttons didn’t restore correctly after restarting the game.
[*] Added a label clarifying that tiny stats cannot be converted, helping to avoid confusion.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.12 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added colored frames to make it easier to identify item rarity.
[*] Fixed an issue where slot type icons wouldn’t update after dragging an item.
[*] Raised Multiplier caps: 100 at Lv.100, 200 at Lv.150, and 500 at Lv.200.
[*] Trials can now drop level 200 gems and ×4 multipliers.
[*] Shop can now sell level 200 gems.
[*] Fixed misleading tooltip showing +10% bullet damage as a +10 flat increase.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.11 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a long-standing issue in passive skill node connection logic where nodes forming a closed ring couldn’t be removed individually — the only workaround was using the “Clear” button.
[*] Auto-leveling has been removed, meaning you’ll no longer be interrupted mid-battle with a forced skill choice. From now on, you can level up anytime you like by opening your inventory and pressing the Level Up button.
[*] Removed “+1 Skill Point” popup after level-up.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.10 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added shared storage, which unlocks at character level 200.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused hidden duplication of items in the same slot — on a large scale, this could impact performance.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.9 Update
notes.content: Expanded storage in the home stash with nine added tabs.

notes.title: 1.0.7 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The tooltip now appears on the closest item automatically, and the show button switches it on or off.
[*] The tooltip now stays fully inside the room, preventing it from being cut off when an item is near the arena’s edge.
[*] Reduced the number of gems found in chests during Trials.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Introduced a brief tutorial explaining autoskills
[*] Fixed an issue with key bindings not loading correctly
[*] Trials difficulty has been lowered
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Trials are now significantly more challenging
[*] Infinite lives are now unlocked after completing level 197
[*] Stamina won’t be consumed when no enemies are around
[*] You can now grab chest gems faster
[*] Expanded the stats spreadsheet with more detailed info
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update
notes.content: Added a brief tutorial explaining limited lives and single-use green chests.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Update
notes.content: Fixed unlocking of Trials.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.content: Good news: the settings close button on the main screen now does exactly what it should.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed the sound-volume slider in the pause menu so it now functions correctly.
2. Changed the Action button’s “A” label to a hand icon, so it’s no longer mistaken for a gamepad control.
